context.transcript:
Hello. my name is Sandeep Prakash, and I'm a reporter for the Ridgedell Times.
I'm calling because I'm writing an article about the new production your theater is putting on this weekend.
I saw on your Web site that you don't allow photography during the performance, and I was wondering whether you'd be willing to make an exception.
I'd really like to take some pictures of the sets and actors to publish with my article.
If not, I could come to one of your dress rehearsals.
I'll be out of town tomorrow morning for a celebrity interview, but I'm free to attend a rehearsal any other time this week.
Please give me a call back at 555-0152.
Thanks.
I look forward to hearing from you.
context.transcript_translation:
你好。我的名字是Sandeep Prakash，我是《Ridgedell Times》的记者。
我打电话来是因为我正在撰写一篇关于您的剧院本周末即将上演的新制作的文章。
我在您的网站上看到您不允许在演出期间拍照，我想知道您是否愿意做出例外？
我真的很想拍一些场景和演员的照片，用于我的文章。
如果不行，我可以参加你们的其中一次彩排。
明天早上我要出城进行名人采访，但本周其他时间我有空参加彩排。
请回电555-0152。
谢谢您。
期待您的回复。
